facts.text: Hindsboro was founded in 1874 when the Illinois Midland Railroad opened a line that linked Terre Haute to Peoria.
The village’s historic school building still stands, a quiet reminder of Hindsboro’s long‑standing commitment to its children.
Hindsboro’s residents celebrate their community with rituals that bring young adults back each year, weaving new stories into the town’s tapestry.
The town’s name honors its early settlers, whose deep roots and shared history give Hindsboro a uniquely neighborly spirit.
Hindsboro’s landscape is dotted with modest landmarks—gardens, crafts, and oral histories—that together form the village’s everyday memory.
Dial‑a‑Ride Public Transportation provides a weekly bus service that connects Hindsboro residents to nearby towns and services.
